rows.question: How many days a week can I work from home?
rows.answer: Employees who have completed their three-month probation may work remotely up to three days per week [3].

rows.question: How long may I work from abroad in one year?
rows.answer: Up to 6 unused days may be carried into the next year, but carried days expire on 31 March [1]. Full-time employees receive 26 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays [1].

rows.question: From which day of illness is a doctor's certificate needed?
rows.answer: A medical certificate is required from the fourth consecutive calendar day of absence [1].

rows.question: How long do I have to hand in an expense claim?
rows.answer: Expense claims must be submitted in Trailhead within 45 days of the purchase, with a receipt for every item above 15 euros [1]. Invoices are payable within 30 days [3].

rows.question: How much discount do staff get on products?
rows.answer: Part-time employees receive a pro-rated amount [3]. Staff receive a 40 percent discount on Larkspur products for personal use, limited to 1,500 euros of purchases per year at full retail value [1].

rows.question: How long should I soak the cartridge before storing it?
rows.answer: Before storing the Rill for more than two weeks, soak the cartridge for 10 minutes in a mild bleach solution of 2 ml per litre, then let it dry completely for 48 hours [1].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > Cleaning and storage

rows.question: Can I use the Rill with sea water?
rows.answer: Do not use it with sea water [1].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > What it removes

rows.question: Which seal kit do I order if the base still leaks?
rows.answer: If it still leaks, order seal kit RS-12 [1].
cited: rill_purifier_manual.md, section: Larkspur Rill Water Purifier Manual > Troubleshooting

rows.question: Until what time can I order express delivery?
rows.answer: Express delivery takes one working day, costs 12.50 euros, and is available only for orders placed before 13:00 [1]. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days and costs 4.90 euros [1].

rows.question: Who pays the postage when I return something, and how many days do I have?
rows.answer: The customer pays the return postage unless the item is faulty or we sent the wrong item [1].

rows.question: How do the warranty periods for tents and water purifiers compare?
rows.answer: Water purifiers carry a two-year warranty, and cartridges are excluded because they wear out with use [1]. Tents and backpacks carry a five-year warranty [1].

rows.question: How much parental leave do the primary and the secondary carer get?
rows.answer: The primary carer of a new child receives 22 weeks of fully paid parental leave [1].

rows.question: What is the notice period when I resign?
rows.answer: Employees should tell their line manager about sickness absence before 09:30 on the first day [2]. Leave of more than ten consecutive working days requires approval from both the line manager and the department head [1].
